function.name: report_emergency
function.description: Alert the claims team that someone is hurt or in danger right now, or that the caller may harm themselves. Call it immediately with no words of your own; it speaks the safety line before anything else happens. Not for past incidents that are the subject of a claim.

note.description: A few words on what is happening, from what the caller already said. Never ask the caller for this. No names, dates of birth or phone numbers.

messages.content: If anyone is hurt or in immediate danger, please hang up and call 911 right now. If you are thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988.
Please stay on the line. Are you safe right now?
